faqs.question: How long does a typical project take?
faqs.answer: It depends on the scope. A logo design typically takes 3–5 business days. A full brand identity takes 1–2 weeks. A website takes 2–6 weeks depending on complexity. We'll give you a clear timeline in your proposal — and we stick to it.

faqs.question: Do you work with businesses outside Nairobi?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We work with clients across Kenya and East Africa. For design, web, SEO, and social media work, everything can be handled remotely. For physical services like signage and vehicle branding, we can discuss logistics depending on your location.

faqs.question: How much does it cost?
faqs.answer: Every project is unique, so we don't publish fixed prices — we'd rather give you an accurate quote than a ballpark figure that doesn't reflect your actual needs. Contact us with a brief summary of what you need and we'll get back to you with a detailed, transparent proposal. There are no hidden fees.

faqs.question: What information do you need to get started?
faqs.answer: Don't worry if you don't have everything figured out — that's partly what we're here for. The more context you can give us about your business, your target audience, and what you're trying to achieve, the better. If you have existing brand materials, share those too. We'll ask the right questions to fill in any gaps.

faqs.question: Do you offer ongoing support after a project is completed?
faqs.answer: Yes — and this is something we actively encourage. Your brand will evolve, your website will need updates, and your marketing needs will grow. We offer ongoing retainer packages for web maintenance, social media, SEO, and general creative support so you always have a trusted partner on hand.

faqs.question: Can you handle multiple services at once?
faqs.answer: Yes — and it actually works better that way. When one team handles your design, your website, your print, and your social media, everything stays consistent. There's no briefing multiple agencies or trying to make sure different suppliers match your brand guidelines. We coordinate everything internally, so you get a seamless result.

faqs.question: What payment terms do you offer?
faqs.answer: We typically require a 50% deposit to begin work, with the balance due on completion. For larger projects or ongoing retainers, we can discuss phased payment schedules. We accept M-Pesa, bank transfer, and other payment methods convenient to you.

case_studies.title: How Horizon Logistics went from invisible to unmistakable
case_studies.challenge: Horizon Logistics had been operating for 8 years with a logo designed on Microsoft Word. Despite being one of the most reliable logistics firms in Nairobi, clients consistently underestimated their scale and professionalism at first impression.
case_studies.approach: We conducted a full brand audit and competitor analysis, then developed a new visual identity system — logo, typography, colour palette, and brand guide. This was applied across a redesigned website, a full stationery suite, and a fleet branding programme covering all 22 vehicles.

case_studies.title: How Afrique Media tripled their organic traffic in 90 days
case_studies.challenge: Afrique Media had strong editorial content but almost no online visibility. Their website was buried on page 4 of Google for their most important keywords, and organic traffic had flatlined for 18 months.
case_studies.approach: We started with a comprehensive technical SEO audit, fixing 47 crawl errors and improving site speed by 62%. We then developed a keyword strategy targeting 28 high-intent search terms relevant to the Kenyan media market and built a content calendar to support each one consistently over 12 weeks.

case_studies.title: How Pearl Properties turned social media into their top lead source
case_studies.tag: Social Media · Content Creation · Paid Ads
case_studies.challenge: Pearl Properties had active social media accounts but no strategy — sporadic posting, inconsistent visuals, and almost zero engagement from potential buyers. Their sales team was relying entirely on word-of-mouth referrals.
case_studies.approach: We rebuilt their social presence from the ground up: a new content strategy focused on lifestyle and aspiration, professionally designed post templates consistent with their brand, a 3-posts-per-week publishing schedule, and targeted paid ads reaching potential buyers in specific Nairobi neighbourhoods. Community management was handled daily to respond to every enquiry and comment.
